title: Does regular-season transfer outperform postseason adjustment?

findings.rule: Lower Brier is better; no model is promoted from a small sample.

conclusion: Transfer (A) Brier 0.2521 vs adjusted (B) 0.2582 on n=362. Delta +0.0061 against adjustment. Permanent experiment; no superiority is declared.
provenance: Derived 2026-09-22 from EXP_A and EXP_B in this file (bets-table metrics). Calculation, not a new backtest.

title: Does a dedicated postseason model outperform the transfer control?

findings.rule: Lower Brier is better; series-state ROI uses n_verified=38 and is INSUFFICIENT_SAMPLE for an edge claim.

provenance: Derived 2026-09-22 from EXP_A and EXP_C in this file. Calculation, not a new backtest.

title: Does hierarchical partial pooling improve calibration?

findings.rule: Lower Brier is better; hierarchical verified ROI +4.0% on 123 priced bets remains INCONCLUSIVE.

conclusion: Transfer (A) Brier 0.2521 n=362 vs hierarchical (E) 0.2594 n=385. Partial pooling does not improve calibration versus transfer in this snapshot. Permanent experiment; no superiority is declared.
